title: Jacob Blessing the Children of Joseph (Rembrandt, 1656), painting
depicts: Genesis 48 (Jacob blesses Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh); not a portrait of an author
artist: Rembrandt (Commons credit: Web Gallery of Art)
licence_shown: Public domain (Commons License 'pd'; LicenseShortName 'Public domain'; UsageTerms 'Public domain')
what_i_see: Oil painting, signed 'Rembrandt f. 1656' lower left. Old Jacob in white robe, lying in bed under a red coverlet, lays his right hand on the head of a kneeling boy (the younger, Ephraim, in Gen 48:14). Joseph in a turban stands behind him. A second boy looks out from under the coverlet. A standing woman in a dark gown with a gold chain stands at right and is not named on the Commons page.
